rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person who willingly does what they are told.

example.english: My son was very compliant today; when I told him to put away his toys, he did it right away.
example.traditional: 個仔今日好聽話，叫佢收玩具就即刻收。
example.jyutping: go3 zai2 gam1 jat6 hou2 teng1 waa6 giu3 keoi5 sau1 wun6 geoi6 zau6 zik1 hak1 sau1

rows.note: Use this when something follows the applicable rules, requirements, or laws.

example.english: This safety helmet is compliant with the regulations and can be worn on a construction site.
example.traditional: 呢個安全帽符合規定，可以喺工地戴。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 on1 cyun4 mou2 fu4 hap6 kwai1 ding6 ho2 ji5 hai2 gung1 dei6 daai3

rows.note: Use this specifically for meeting technical, quality, or industry standards rather than general rules.

example.english: This batch of drinking water is compliant with the required standards and is safe to drink.
example.traditional: 呢批食水經檢驗，符合標準，可以放心飲用。
example.jyutping: ne1 pai1 sik6 seoi2 ging1 gim2 jim6 fu4 hap6 biu1 zeon2 ho2 ji5 fong3 sam1 jam2 jung6
